settings.editor:
We are a boutique property management team based in Los Altos. For more than ten years we have helped Bay Area homeowners rent their properties with confidence, without the stress of handling tenants, repairs and paperwork on their own.

We keep our portfolio small on purpose. That way every owner gets personal attention, honest advice and a team that treats their home like its own.

We work with owners in English and Mandarin (中文), whether you live in the Bay Area, out of state or overseas.

settings.title: Less stress for you, more from your rental.

settings.editor: Owning a rental should grow your wealth, not take over your weekends. We handle the day-to-day work so you can enjoy the returns with confidence.
A single point of contact who knows your property, your tenants and your goals.
Smart pricing and strong marketing help your home rent quickly, so it keeps earning.
One clear management fee, no surprise charges and no markup on repairs.
No long lock-in contracts. Simple terms that keep you in control of your property.
Full-service management for single-family homes, condos and small multi-unit properties. Everything you need, under one roof.

tabs.tab_title: How much does property management cost?
tabs.tab_content: Full management is 8% of the monthly rent collected, and leasing only is 75% of the first month’s rent. There are no hidden fees and no markup on maintenance.
Every applicant goes through credit, background, income and rental history checks. We verify employment and speak with previous landlords before recommending anyone to you.

tabs.tab_title: How quickly can you rent my home?
tabs.tab_content: Most homes rent within two to three weeks. Smart pricing, professional photos and quick showings keep vacant days to a minimum.

tabs.tab_title: What happens with the security deposit?
tabs.tab_content: We collect and hold the deposit in line with California law, document the home at move-in and move-out, and handle any deductions with a clear, itemized statement.
